verdict.rationale: The only recurring-workflow feature shown is manual recurring invoicing via UI clicks (docs-14), not an AI-native or programmatic scheduling mechanism. The API and MCP layer that would let agents automate/schedule bookkeeping workflows is explicitly described as future ('soon a full accounting API... an MCP layer will let AI agents handle bookkeeping tasks end-to-end'), and probes confirm no live API/OpenAPI spec exists yet (mercury-books-probe-2). No evidence of a shipped mechanism for AI-native users to schedule recurring jobs/workflows today.
